full_name: Anikó Imre | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Anikó Imre is a comparative media and communications scholar who will research how fantasy-based, world-building activities across media forms and platforms enable the synergy between corporate capitalism and illiberal nationalism in post-socialist laboratories of “entrepreneurial authoritarianism.” Her book will outline a new, interdisciplinary perspective that pivots around storytelling and will offer more effective ways of tackling political polarization within platform capitalism.
